meta.title: Security and Data Protection | DocumentoIQ
meta.description: Learn how DocumentoIQ protects your information with Google Cloud infrastructure, advanced encryption, and granular access control.

hero.title: Security and data protection in DocumentoIQ
hero.subtitle: DocumentoIQ is designed to operate in environments where confidentiality, precision, and traceability are critical.
hero.microcopy: Designed for legal, notary, and financial sectors.

infrastructure.title: How we protect our customers' information
infrastructure.description: DocumentoIQ operates entirely on managed services from Google Cloud Platform (GCP), eliminating risks associated with physical servers or poorly managed local infrastructure. Furthermore, it uses certified enterprise services widely adopted by banks, insurers, and regulated organisations.

benefits.title: Benefits for our customers
items: Physical and logical protection managed by Google
Secure scalability for large document volumes

protection.title: Data protection in transit and at rest
protection.description: All information processed by DocumentoIQ is protected using modern encryption mechanisms.

transit.title: Encryption in transit
transit.description: All communication uses HTTPS and TLS 1.2 or higher. This includes:

rest.title: Encryption at rest
rest.description: Documents and metadata stored in Google Cloud use automatic AES-256 encryption managed by Google.

signedUrls.title: Signed URLs and temporary access
signedUrls.description: Document downloads and uploads use short-duration temporary links. This significantly reduces the risk of unauthorised access.

access.title: Permission-based access control
access.description: DocumentoIQ implements secure authentication and a granular permission model.

authentication.title: Secure authentication
authentication.description: The platform uses Firebase Authentication, including encrypted passwords, automatic token rotation, protection against brute-force attacks, and secure sessions.

session.title: Automatic session logout
session.description: Sessions close automatically after periods of inactivity to protect sensitive documents on unattended devices.

pbac.title: Granular permissions (PBAC)
pbac.description: Each action within DocumentoIQ validates the user's identity and whether they have specific permissions to perform the operation. This allows much more precise control than traditional "admin / non-admin" models.

isolation.title: Total isolation between companies
isolation.description: DocumentoIQ is built under a multi-tenant architecture (also called "multi-client"), where each company operates within its own isolated logical space, separated from the rest of the organisations using the platform.

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.description: DocumentoIQ maintains a log of actions on sensitive information, allowing clarity on who accessed, deleted, or generated an extraction.

ai.title: Secure processing with enterprise AI providers
ai.description: DocumentoIQ only uses leading and certified providers for intelligent document processing.

important.title: Important
important.description: DocumentoIQ does not use unmanaged open models or providers without a formal security posture.

responsibleUse.title: Responsible use of AI
responsibleUse.description: Models are used in inference mode to process documents, not to train models with customer information.

cta.title: Security designed for critical documents
cta.description: DocumentoIQ was created for organisations working with sensitive information that require precision, traceability, and control at every stage of document processing.
cta.microcopy: Available for due diligence processes and provider evaluations.

items.question: Where are my documents stored?
items.answer: In secure Google Cloud Platform infrastructure.

items.question: Can DocumentoIQ access my documents?
items.answer: Technical access is restricted, audited, and controlled. There is no central interface where documents are freely visible.

items.question: What happens if I stop using DocumentoIQ?
items.answer: There is a formal procedure for definitive data deletion per company.

items.question: Do you comply with international standards?
items.answer: DocumentoIQ relies on infrastructure certified under SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27018, HIPAA-eligible infrastructure, and other compliance programs.
